# JTT Icons

Open-source SVG icon system by BY JTT.

Site: https://icons.byjtt.com
Repository: https://github.com/jordan-thirkle/icons-byjtt
Catalogue: https://icons.byjtt.com/icons.json

## AI coding agents
Use icons.json as the canonical catalogue. Resolve natural-language requests against name, title, category and tags. Published names are stable identifiers. Retrieve /icons/{name}.svg when available. Prefer structured data or raw SVG over scraping rendered UI. License: MIT.
